demo-cover.png.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: a single editorial cover illustration used as sample media inside real screenshots of Tattoo, a self-hosted writing workspace.
Primary request: a refined, calm cover for an article about building a lightweight writing system and keeping everyday inspiration.
Scene: a beautifully arranged writing desk seen from an elevated three-quarter angle. One open blank ivory notebook with sculptural, gently curved paper pages, a closed deep forest-green notebook underneath, one slender graphite pencil, one small warm ochre bookmark. Quiet morning sunlight and a soft leaf shadow across a warm off-white surface. A tiny sage paper slip can add a restrained geometric accent.
Style: realistic tactile still-life photography, sophisticated editorial art direction, matte paper, natural grain, controlled soft shadows. Restrained and inviting, with one clear focal point.
Composition: wide horizontal 16:9, subject centered with generous breathing room and safe crop margins, notebook and paper the main subject. No human hands.
Palette: ivory, warm white, deep forest green #35634e, muted sage, one tiny ochre accent.
Constraints: absolutely no text, lettering, writing, logos, branding, watermark, computer UI, robots, AI sparkles or neon effects. The notebook pages are completely blank. No decorative clutter.
